conditions: Index must be bound to current project/revision identity.
exclusions: writing source from stale index state

claims.statement: The index is built from bounded project files into typed document/symbol/reference records.
Queries should return stable semantic identities plus source revisions so callers can detect staleness.
Source files remain authoritative; the semantic index can be discarded and rebuilt.

mechanisms.description: walk admitted source files and build document/symbol records

mechanisms.description: resolve references/imports within the project index

mechanisms.description: serve typed queries with revision/provenance information

content.summary: The semantic code index is an immutable/rebuildable project projection of documents, symbols, references, imports, and diagnostics with stable revision-scoped identities; it supports navigation and reasoning but is not source-code authority.
